title: Summary
summary: The screen after a drill or a conversation: the grade first, what it did to mastery, what was missed.
description: The summary is about the go just finished. It celebrates as much as the grade earned, shows what the misses kept from it, and keeps the longer term to one muted row.

stories.as: a learner who just finished a drill or a conversation
stories.want: to see my grade and what it did to the lesson's mastery points first
stories.soThat: I know at once how it went

stories.as: a learner who did not pass
stories.want: to see what I missed and what more it would have earned, without being cheered
stories.soThat: I know what to fix and what happens next

stories.as: a learner who just mastered a lesson

stories.soThat: the go I just finished stays the point

requirements.text: After a drill or a conversation the summary shows, top to bottom: the grade, the lesson's mastery points, what was missed, a course completed or mastered and achievements just earned, the longer-term row, and Done.

The grade comes first, as its term's shown word (Aced, Passed, Partly there, Not yet), with the lesson's title and a drill's score as right answers of the cards scored, each almost counting half; extra practice is named beside it, and a go with nothing scored says `summary.not-graded` instead.

Under the grade, the lesson's mastery points are a bar from before the go to after it, with the change and out of `mastery.full`, exactly as the go's row in the mastery ledger has them, with `summary.capped` or `summary.after-mastered` when that row's reason is one of those.

history.text: Under the grade, the lesson's mastery points are a bar from before the go to after it, with the change and out of `mastery.full`, exactly as the go's row in the mastery ledger has them, with `summary.capped`, `summary.fail-extra` or `summary.after-mastered` when that row's reason is one of those.
history.reason: No go takes points away any more, so extra practice needs no reassurance that it cannot.

requirements.text: One line under the mastery says when the lesson comes back: `summary.back-on` after a pass, `summary.partial-next` after a partial, `summary.fail-next` after a fail, and `summary.extra-next` on extra practice.
An ace is celebrated most, with confetti and the points counting up; a pass is celebrated with confetti; a partial is encouraged without confetti.
A fail is not celebrated: no confetti, no celebration sound or emoji.

history.text: A fail, or a go that cost mastery points, is not celebrated: no confetti, no celebration sound or emoji.
history.reason: No go loses mastery points any more, so only the grade decides whether a go is celebrated.

requirements.text: The cards answered wrong or almost right in a drill are listed with the prompt, the answer given struck through and the right answer, an almost marked as one; a word's or sentence's row opens its page, and with nothing missed there is no list. A conversation lists what the verdict says to go over.

Above the misses, one line says what they kept from the go, worked out by the rules that graded it: how many more right answers would have passed it (from a pass, aced it) and the mastery change that would have made instead of the go's own (shown as 0 when it earned none), as `summary.impact-drill` or, for a conversation, `summary.impact-conversation`; a drill adds `summary.missed-sooner`.

history.text: Above the misses, one line says what they cost, worked out by the rules that graded the go: how many more right answers would have passed it (from a pass, aced it) and the mastery change that would have made, as `summary.impact-drill` or, for a conversation, `summary.impact-conversation`; a drill adds `summary.missed-sooner`.
history.reason: Misses no longer cost points, only points not earned, so the go's own change can be nothing but never a loss.

requirements.text: A go that masters its lesson gets a celebration of its own in place of the pass's: the Mastered badge, the lesson's title and `summary.mastered-line`, with motion of its own; a course completed or mastered by the same go is told on the same screen without a second celebration.
The longer term is one muted row at the bottom: the go's XP and today's, the streak, a streak freeze only when this go earned one, and `summary.day-done` only when this go finished today's lessons.
The summary shows no all-time accuracy, no percentage for the go, and no XP as a headline number.

values.value: Nothing was scored, so it isn't graded: its mastery and schedule stay as they were.
